name: ApprovalRecord
description:
The record of a decided approval: one line in the transcript. While it is approved and
running it carries Revoke; it updates in place to executed, failed or revoked.

props.name: ask
props.type: import("../types.js").ApprovalAsk & { id: string; question: string; detail?: string; status?: import("../types.js").AskState; answer?: string; answeredBy?: string; answeredByEntity?: import("../types.js").EntityRef; answeredAt?: number; submitLabel?: string; }
props.description: The typed request and its current resolution state.

props.name: onRevoke
props.description: While approved and not yet run: withdraw it (RevokeAiApproval).
